drug_interactions.effect: aqueous extracts inhibited CYP450 in vitro; no clinical interactions reported
drug_interactions.md: aqueous extracts inhibited CYP450 [in vitro](#term:in-vitro); no clinical [interactions](#term:drug-interaction) reported

pregnancy_lactation.statement: 'Safety during pregnancy and lactation has not been established... use during pregnancy and lactation is not recommended' (EMA).
pregnancy_lactation.md: 'Safety during pregnancy and lactation has not been established... use during pregnancy and lactation is not recommended' ([EMA](#term:ema-hmpc)).

allergy.statement: Very rare hypersensitivity; possible cross-reactivity within Lamiaceae; contact dermatitis and asthma from thyme dust; one anaphylaxis case reported.
allergy.md: Very rare hypersensitivity; possible [cross-reactivity](#term:cross-reactivity) within [Lamiaceae](#term:lamiaceae); [contact dermatitis](#term:contact-allergen) and asthma from thyme dust; one [anaphylaxis](#term:anaphylaxis) case reported.

adverse_event_history.statement: Mostly mild gastrointestinal or skin reactions; one case of acute hepatitis after ingesting pure thyme essential oil.
adverse_event_history.md: Mostly mild gastrointestinal or skin reactions; one case of acute [hepatitis](#term:hepatotoxicity) after ingesting pure thyme [essential oil](#term:essential-oil).

contraindications.statement: Hypersensitivity to thyme or other Lamiaceae [9]
contraindications.md: Hypersensitivity to thyme or other Lamiaceae [9](#cite:9)

constituents_of_concern.concern: historical vermifuge doses far above medicinal exposure caused abdominal pain and collapse
constituents_of_concern.threshold_or_limit: EMA estimates ~38 mg thymol daily from medicinal thyme use (context, not a limit)
constituents_of_concern.md: historical vermifuge doses far above medicinal exposure caused abdominal pain and collapse

evidence.claim: A thyme + ivy fluid-extract syrup reduced coughing fits in acute bronchitis faster than placebo.
evidence.test_article_detail: fixed fluid extract combination of thyme herb and ivy leaves, 11 days
evidence.outcome_summary: Coughing fits -68.7 % vs -47.6 % by days 7-9 (p < 0.0001; n = 361).
evidence.note: Two-herb product; not transferable to thyme alone or to thyme honey.

md.claim: A thyme + ivy fluid-extract syrup reduced coughing fits in acute bronchitis faster than [placebo](#term:placebo).
md.outcome_summary: Coughing fits -68.7 % vs -47.6 % by days 7-9 (p < 0.0001; n = 361).
